Added: Seven class-focused cards bring the catalog to 25, with strength, poison, faith and magic strategies.
Each new reward offers two class cards and one shared card; labels show the category and copies already owned.
Rage Band, Venom Vial and Sunward Seal bring equipment to nine items. Poison and healing gear apply through card tags.
Changed: New starter decks contain four or five affinity cards instead of two signature cards.
Shared equipment costs more, and the forge shows how many cards in your current deck each item supports.
Quickstep grants four block without drawing; a free play now spends hand space.
Existing runs retain their saved decks and pending rewards. Updated card and equipment tuning applies to future actions.
Fixed: Hero CSV imports retain consistent line endings and reject invalid affinity references without replacing content.
The content editor now explains that changed definitions require restarting Play mode or rebuilding/reloading the player.
KnownIssues: Physical Android/iOS devices and graphical Windows play remain unverified; Android APK is for testing.
Adapted campaign does not include every mechanic or content item from the original browser game.
Two inherited browser CI inventory failures remain documented and waived for this work.
Unattended Unity compilation still requires runner/licensing setup; Pages publication is automated for packaged builds.
Fixed-policy tests show faster Starseer runs and slower Herald runs; class balance still needs player feedback.
